messages:
Maya (CSM): quick weekly sync on VegaHealth — token velocity + throughput trends/QoQ & WoW
Rohit (CSM): thanks, Maya. TL;DR: steady growth, small midweek spike Wed, slight burn vs forecast :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Maya (CSM): numbers from telemetry: WoW +12% tokens/day, QoQ +28%. average tokens/day now ~1.9M. hit 2.4M peak last Wed during import job.
Lin (Data Eng): confirming — import job created a sustained tail; batching dropped for a 45m window. raw metric dump: ```peak_ingress_rps: 2300
avg_rps_during_spike: 1800
p95_latency_ms: 420 -> baseline 180```
Nora (SRE): saw increased retry rate too. error rate rose from 0.12% -> 0.9% during that window. suspect downstream DB queueing. I put an alert rule to suppress noisy retries.
Maya (CSM): billing note — spend this week +18% WoW, still within committed tiers but approaching burst overage threshold. flagged on the account.
Rohit (CSM): renewal risk? current MRR healthy but if spend stays +15% MoM we should discuss reserve capacity or Dedicated promo. low-medium risk if not addressed.
Lin (Data Eng): quick mitigation: we can enable more aggressive KV cache for the import path and enforce a 50ms client-side pacing. small code change on their client.
Maya (CSM): scheduled enablement with VegaHealth for Friday 11am PT to walk through pacing + retry best practices. invite sent to their eng leads.
Nora (SRE): ops action: I'll run a short repro in staging to validate DB queueing and patch our connection pool defaults. ETA: EOD Thu.
Rohit (CSM): customer feedback: they noted higher latency on longer sequences, asking about quantized model options. flagged to product/solutions for a call.
Maya (CSM): action items: 1) Lin — KV cache toggle + client pacing PR by Thu EOD; 2) Nora — staging repro + pool tweak; 3) Rohit — discuss Dedicated vs burst cushion in renewal convo.
Lin (Data Eng): noted. PR branch `vega-cache-fix` created, small config flag. link: https://git.internal/r/vega-cache-fix :rocket:
deploy-bot: deploy started for branch vega-cache-fix -> staging at 3105556750
Nora (SRE): staging deploy looks green so far, p95 down to 190ms in test load. will monitor for 2 cycles.
Maya (CSM): thanks team — will capture next-week WoW snapshot after Friday session and update VegaHealth renewal playbook. :memo:
Rohit (CSM): +1, tagging @account-exec to prep renewal options. :thumbsup:
Maya (CSM): closing thread for now — will post follow-up after enablement.
